eurostat_integration.selection_rule: Official total dimensions selected (age=TOTAL, sex=T, and c_birth=TOTAL or citizen=TOTAL as applicable); no summing across disaggregated categories; where both age definitions appear, prefer COMPLET and otherwise retain REACH.
eurostat_integration.caveat: Eurostat data were uploaded by the user and processed locally; they were not newly downloaded live. Values remain missing where source data are absent/suppressed. National migration flows are contextual macro outcomes, not MBA pathway success.
